color.note: Paper and ink carry the page. Color is evidence: flow direction, estimates, and the highlighter. Every text pair in the usage notes holds 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Tables, charts and text sit directly on it; separate things with rules and space, not boxes.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: tooltips, popovers, menus. Pair with shadow-pop.

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: Table header bands, row hover wash, meter and gap-strip tracks, input wells.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, section rules, chart gridlines. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, chart zero lines and axes, stamp outlines, de-emphasized chart dots. At least 3:1 on paper, paper-raised, paper-shade and highlight in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every filed fact: share counts, position values, holder counts, dates. Also the conviction fill, the price dot and the focus ring. Readable on every paper token, highlight and the three soft tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, axis ticks, as-of lines, table headers. At least 4.5:1 on paper, paper-raised, paper-shade and highlight in both themes.

tokens.name: flow-in
tokens.usage: Money in: net buying, new and added positions. Bars, direction triangles, and short text such as tags and signed deltas on paper, paper-raised, paper-shade and flow-in-soft. Never used for anything but flow direction.

tokens.name: flow-in-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind flow-in text, e.g. the Add tag.

tokens.name: flow-out
tokens.usage: Money out: net selling, trimmed and exited positions. Same rules as flow-in: marks and short text on paper, paper-raised, paper-shade and flow-out-soft.

tokens.name: flow-out-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind flow-out text, e.g. the Trim tag.

tokens.name: on-flow
tokens.usage: Text on a solid flow-in or flow-out fill: the New and Exit tags.

tokens.name: estimate
tokens.usage: The blue pen: anything a model produced rather than a filing (fair-value ranges, valuation gaps, scores). Text and marks on paper, paper-raised, paper-shade and estimate-soft. Always labeled est.

tokens.name: estimate-soft
tokens.usage: Fair-value range bands and the valuation-gap badge behind estimate text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The highlighter: a wash behind the few rows, points or phrases where accumulation and a valuation gap agree. At most five per view, always with the Worth a look flag. Text directly on it is ink or ink-muted; tags and badges keep their own grounds.

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: Newsreader names things. It never sets numbers in tables or figures.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: Page title: the company, manager or screen the page is about. One per page.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Titles of tables, charts and panels. Name the period.

styles.name: type-note
styles.sample: Fair value is a range from three models, not a price target.
styles.usage: Method notes, caveats and footnotes, in the analyst's voice.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Public Sans carries data and controls. Tabular figures in columns, proportional in key figures.

styles.name: type-figure
styles.usage: Key figure values. Proportional figures. One row of key figures per view at most.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: 31 of 42 tracked managers added shares last quarter.

styles.name: type-data
styles.usage: Table cells, chart values and axis ticks. Always tabular-nums, numbers right-aligned.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Control labels, legends, tooltip labels, meter captions.

styles.name: type-caption
styles.usage: Eyebrows, table headers, stamps and tags. Always uppercase.

groups.name: Identifiers
groups.note: The system mono, for strings people copy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to number, triangle to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags, stamps and controls; label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell sides; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between components; panel padding; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above the page title; page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, stamps, the Worth a look flag.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Bar data ends, buttons, inputs, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots only: the price marker and map points.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Only floating layers and focus get one.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Tooltips, popovers and menus on paper-raised.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px paper gap, then a solid 2px ink ring.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Table row height.

tokens.name: size-tag
tokens.usage: Tag, stamp and flag height.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: Flow bar thickness (never more than 24px).

tokens.name: size-meter
tokens.usage: Conviction meter and gap-strip track height.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content.
